title: Kalkschuttfächer A
description: Rundum bedeckter größengestufter Kalktalus mit 64 individuellen kantigen Platten und Keilen sowie 1100 modellierten Kieseln zwischen den Blöcken. Große Bruchstücke liegen am Schuttfuß aller Seiten, kleinere hangaufwärts; der Rand dünnt natürlich aus. Breite frische Bruchflächen und je Keim variierendes gerichtetes Feinkorn ersetzen gleichmäßig gehämmerte Grübchen. Sechzehn warme Kreide- und Kalkvarianten mit lokalem Fugenschmutz, ohne dunkle Schiefersteine. Ein geschlossener 32-Grad-Kalkfeinkieskörper füllt die Zwischenräume; wenige Grasbüschel sitzen am Rand.

review.notes: Round 3 (last): rejected. Fixed: the talus is now graded all round (large toe blocks, smaller fragments and modelled gravel upslope, no bare side), and the dimple pattern and slate-grey stones are gone (sheet turns, closeup_base). Still failing: (1) form_detail 7: every stone is a smooth, soft-edged wedge with a few large flat facets and rounded edges, like putty or clay; no sharp break edges, conchoidal scars or chipped corners (closeup, closeup_base foreground). (2) material/style 7: all stones are one even taupe-grey with only faint smeared streaks, not the pale broken chalk of STYLE.md, and the bed between them is a smooth, stained sand cone rather than gravel and fines (closeup_base centre). (3) defects 7: several toe blocks interpenetrate each other with no contact detail, and the edge grass is barely visible. Fix: give the stones crisp fracture edges with secondary chips and spalled faces; use the pale chalk material with per-stone tone variation and darker undersides; replace the smooth sand with grit and small fragments filling the gaps; separate or seat the toe blocks against each other; show tufts of edge grass at the foot.
